questions.prompt: Compute \(\int_0^2\int_0^3 (x+y)\,dx\,dy\).
questions.answer: Integrate with respect to \(x\) first: \[\int_0^3(x+y)\,dx=\left[\frac{x^2}{2}+yx\right]_0^3=\frac92+3y\] Then integrate over \(y\): \[\int_0^2\left(\frac92+3y\right)dy=9+6=15\]

questions.prompt: A rectangle has sides \(4\) and \(5\) with density \(2\). Find its mass.
questions.answer: Mass is density times area: \[m=\iint_R2\,dA=2(4)(5)=40\] The double integral gives the same result as direct area multiplication.
